description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Dawn Light
sections.description_summary: Dionel soars and becomes untargetable for 6 s, attacking the densest enemy area with spear thrusts. The final hit knocks enemies airborne.

sections.name: Starry Void
sections.description_summary: Passive normal attack becomes a Penetration attack that hits all enemies along its path.

sections.name: Nectar Feast
sections.description_summary: Temporary allied stat buffs add Intoxication stacks, increasing ATK and ATK SPD up to three stacks. Active cast drinks nectar to increase ATK and ATK SPD for 12 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Normal attacks permanently increase ATK SPD during battle, up to a cap.

sections.name: Celestial Spear
sections.description_summary: When Intoxication is fully stacked, summons a light spear that deals true damage to all enemies, up to three casts per battle. LV 3 adds max-HP-based true damage and reduces Vitality.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Increases Execution during Nectar Feast; LV 2 speeds up drinking, grants a shield during the effect and adds Execution at max Intoxication.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD and normal-attack lifesteal; higher ranks add Penetration above 50% HP.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Rain of Blades
sections.description_summary: Summons Flying Swords for nine strikes against the highest-HP enemy; each strike deals ATK damage plus current-HP-based extra damage, capped by Salazer's ATK.

sections.name: Enraptured Whip
sections.description_summary: Damages enemies in a 2-tile arc; if the target's HP falls below 70%, launches another attack.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases damage reduction.

sections.name: Soul Drench
sections.description_summary: Casts Enraptured Whip without cooldown at battle start or when an enemy is imprisoned; higher ranks add current-HP-based damage and extra whip casts.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Heals Salazer for every imprisoned enemy. LV 2 increases Spirit Shackles damage and grants a shield when a previously imprisoned enemy is defeated.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Deals magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals Salazer; higher ranks add opening unaffected duration.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Winged Flame
sections.description_summary: Selects a direction and summons a 3-tile-wide wall of flame, dealing high damage to burned enemies.

sections.name: Bone Sear
sections.description_summary: Burns one enemy for 10 s, prioritizing unburned enemies.

sections.name: Fireball Singe
sections.description_summary: A fireball damages the target and adjacent enemies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD.

sections.name: Dance of Flames
sections.description_summary: After the first Winged Flame, Fireball Singe becomes Mirael's normal attack for the rest of battle and fires two fireballs. Higher levels add more Bone Sear targets and damage.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Extends Bone Sear duration; LV 2 increases cooldown and targets burned enemies, while granting Mirael a large temporary ATK SPD increase.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Soul Shepherd
sections.description_summary: Protects the weakest ally from a fatal blow, turns them into a Spirit and restores HP. The Spirit deals reduced damage while losing HP over time; Niru can target himself if no other ally remains.

sections.name: Soul Reaping
sections.description_summary: Attacks the weakest enemy with extra damage based on lost HP.

sections.name: Spirit Devour
sections.description_summary: Damages all enemies with max-HP-based extra damage and heals the weakest ally by an equal amount.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases HP.

sections.name: Ethereal Form
sections.description_summary: At battle start casts Ultimate on the nearest ally without Energy cost, with backline priority. Higher ranks delay Spirit HP loss until allies enter Spirit form.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Soul Reaping prevents target HP recovery for 8 s. LV 2 modifies Spirit Devour and grants defensive buffs to Shemira or Daimon when healed.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening ranged-damage buff to the ally placed one tile behind; higher ranks add a conditional shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

source_notes: The source explicitly documents targeting rules, but the extraction batch does not transcribe their exact selection details. Keep targeting metadata separate; do not infer values.

sections.name: Seed Siphon
sections.description_summary: Teleports to an enemy, prevents movement/actions, deals damage and drains Energy, planting a Drain Seed. The seed periodically damages its host and reduces Energy; seeds drop when the host is defeated or Saida casts Ultimate on that host again.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: At battle start, plants Drain Seeds on two nearby allies; seeds do not harm allies and instead grant shields.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

capture_status_notes: The excerpt does not include the full base kit, Hero Focus, Exclusive Equipment or all Enhance Force details; recapture required.

sections.name: Detention Pass
sections.description_summary: Opening passive hides Contess in her rulebook; she cannot move/act or be targeted and recovers Energy until a condition reveals her. Active cast heals an ally and grants Exemption. Exemption protects that ally from Contess's rule-violation punishment; while ally HP remains above 40%, loses max HP over time, converting part of the loss into a capped shield and ATK increase.

capture_status_notes: The capture excerpt ends during Ultimate description; other skills and progression sections require recapture.

sections.name: Wild Shift
sections.description_summary: Immobilizes two rearmost enemies, teleports them to a target tile and drops them, damaging and knocking down enemies there. Passive: each skill has a 20% chance to go out of control and teleport its target to a random enemy-side location.

sections.name: Mad Missiles
sections.description_summary: Fires nine magic missiles at enemies in quick succession.

sections.name: Mage's Bloom
sections.description_summary: Prevents the first cast of each skill from going out of control; skill casts can trigger mutation. Mutated damage creates adjacent true damage and immobilization.

capture_status_notes: The capture excerpt does not show all skills, Hero Focus, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode; recapture the remainder.

sections.name: Heroic Slash
sections.description_summary: Performs nine slashes in a frontal area, then a wide sweep with max-HP-based true damage.

sections.name: Heroic Dash
sections.description_summary: Dashes to the two enemies with the highest cumulative damage, damages and knocks them down, then returns to the original position; unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: In Boss Fights, Himmel and party members cause 12% more HP loss on Boss targets.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Himmel's own-skill displacement grants ATK; higher ranks also grant a shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

source_notes: A returned later section describes Blue-Moon Blessings: a later battlefield sweep heals all party members and removes debuffs; surviving party members increase Himmel's ATK. Further text specifies different max-HP/ATK bonuses for Tank/Support versus Mage/Himmel. The heading/section mapping is not established in this extraction batch; retained as source note rather than invented as an ability.

sections.name: Mid-Air Shot
sections.description_summary: Leaps up to two tiles and shoots the two closest enemies to the initial tile.

sections.name: Mighty Arrow
sections.description_summary: After every two normal attacks, charges the next normal attack to deal increased damage and stun.

sections.name: Hyperfocus
sections.description_summary: When no enemy is within 2 tiles, increases ATK and ATK SPD.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Crit DMG Boost.

sections.name: Starlight Waltz
sections.description_summary: The twins fight separately but share HP and Energy. Active dance increases all allies' Haste for 7 s; allies linked by Stellar Bond become unaffected during the dance.

sections.name: Stellar Bond
sections.description_summary: Elijah forms a bond with Lailah when they align; allies in a straight path between the twins also become linked.
